session.ceoQuestion: We have a $120,000 cap and six weeks to pilot faster onboarding. We do not yet have a savings baseline. What should we measure before committing the remaining funds?

followUp.content: Give me one release gate for the second tranche. Distinguish a proposed threshold from measured savings.

exampleRawFollowUp.dialogue: CEO, for the six-week pilot capped at $120,000, I would hold the second tranche until we compare onboarding hours per account against a pre-pilot baseline. A ten percent reduction is my proposed release threshold, not measured savings; we have no baseline yet.
exampleRawFollowUp.knowledgeInsight: Measure onboarding hours per account before the pilot and again before releasing the second tranche. Treat the proposed threshold as a decision rule rather than a forecast.
